cluster_label: body_wall_epidermal cell that specialized in antimicrobial response
working_definition: Adult epidermal cells specialised in antimicrobial peptide response (FCA body wall); authors gave no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epidermal cell of the adult.

justification: No FBbt term for an antimicrobial-specialised epidermal cell; adult epidermal cell is the valid parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of some epidermis.

recommendation: Use adult epidermal cell (FBbt:00058242) as a broad match.
